🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector participation (Health, Staples, Comm, Consumer Discretionary strong) while Technology is weak 1W (Tech: 1W -1.48% | 24 stocks) and top performance is concentrated in software — mixed signals support a neutral stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare lead: JNJ (1W: +3.87% | 1M: +2.72%) ABOVE TREND; PFE (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +5.01%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples lead: KO (1W: +X% | 1M: +X%) ABOVE TREND; MDLZ (1W: +X% | 1M: +X%) ABOVE TREND. Communication/Leisure strong: CHTR (1W: +12.37% | 1M: -0.66%) RECOVERY. (Note: sector counts per summary used; leadership confirmed by positive 1W sector returns.)

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +15.21%) ABOVE TREND but sector 1W -1.16% shows mixed internals. Technology lagging: NVDA (1W: -10.40% | 1M: -2.54%) BELOW TREND; INTC (1W: -20.21% | 1M: -37.84%) BELOW TREND. Utilities weak: VST (1W: -14.35% | 1M: -12.05%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: ACN (1W: +23.61% | 1M: +40.49%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +21.27% | 1M: +15.79%) ABOVE TREND; ADBE (1W: +20.64% | 1M: +27.61%) ABOVE TREND; INTU (1W: +17.11% | 1M: +25.60%) ABOVE TREND; CRM (1W: +15.57% | 1M: +19.28%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology) — caution on concentration.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ETN (1W: -11.07% | 1M: -11.36%) BELOW TREND; QCOM (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -17.51%) BELOW TREND; CAT (1W: -11.99% | 1M: -24.10%) BELOW TREND; INTC (1W: -20.21% | 1M: -37.84%) BELOW TREND; TSLA (1W: -20.24% | 1M: -27.56%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in semiconductors and select industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: ACN (1W: +23.61%), NOW (1W: +21.27%), ADBE (1W: +20.64%), INTU (1W: +17.11%), CRM (1W: +15.57%) — all ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present: NVDA (1W: -10.40% | 1M: -2.54%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -6.63% | 1M: +4.09%) CORRECTION, JPM (1W: -1.01% | 1M: +5.12%) CORRECTION — multiple large-cap divergences warrant caution.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed-to-negative: Tech 1W: -1.48% | 1M: -2.15% (24 stocks). Large-cap divergence — ACN (1W: +23.61% | 1M: +40.49%) ABOVE TREND and peers strong, while NVDA (1W: -10.40% | 1M: -2.54%) BELOW TREND, ASML (1W: -13.83% | 1M: -17.55%) BELOW TREND and INTC/AMAT/AMD deeply BELOW TREND; sector internals uneven.

8. Financials Outlook?
Modest positive: Financials 1W: +0.17% | 1M: +6.07% (20 stocks). V (1W: +4.33% | 1M: +7.93%) ABOVE TREND and MA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +10.72%) ABOVE TREND show resilience; JPM (1W: -1.01% | 1M: +5.12%) CORRECTION suggests short-term dispersion within the group.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Clear strength: Healthcare 1W: +4.69% | 1M: +4.21% (17 stocks). JNJ (1W: +3.87% | 1M: +2.72%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +5.01%) ABOVE TREND, SYK (1W: +13.91% | 1M: +6.86%) ABOVE TREND; LLY (1W: +4.04% | 1M: -1.62%) RECOVERY — defensive exposure favored within neutral regime.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to the high-momentum software cohort (ACN, NOW, ADBE, INTU, CRM) while reducing exposure to weak-cap semiconductors and capital goods (NVDA, INTC, AMD, CAT). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration amid broad sector participation; monitor for dispersion.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: ACN (1W: +23.61% | 1M: +40.49%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +21.27% | 1M: +15.79%) ABOVE TREND; ADBE (1W: +20.64% | 1M: +27.61%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -10.40% | 1M: -2.54%) BELOW TREND; INTC (1W: -20.21% | 1M: -37.84%) BELOW TREND; AMD (1W: -22.23% | 1M: -20.38%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +4.69% | 1M: +4.21%) — depth of leaders. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -2.15%) — watch semiconductor spillover. Monitor Energy for divergence between XOM/CVX strength and sector 1W weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: watch near-term support after the sharp 1W decline (failure to hold recent lows risks further downside). ACN/NOW/ADBE: watch for follow-through above this week’s breakout highs to confirm momentum continuation. JPM: watch hold/break of 1M consolidation for confirmation of its recovery vs. short-term correction.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
PFE (+80): EU approval for updated vaccine; PFE (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +5.01%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. KO (+80): raised guidance; KO (1W: +X% | 1M: +X%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. LRCX (+75): upgraded outlook on AI chip demand; LRCX (1W: -20.97% | 1M: -38.59%) BELOW TREND — sentiment is diverging from price, watch for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
META (-65): forecast miss; META (1W: -6.63% | 1M: +4.09%) CORRECTION — sentiment aligns with 1W weakness. INTC (-60): sharp negative headlines; INTC (1W: -20.21% | 1M: -37.84%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and risk elevated. JNJ (-50): talc settlement headlines; JNJ (1W: +3.87% | 1M: +2.72%) ABOVE TREND — price is holding despite negative news, monitor for settlement details.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership. ACN, NOW, ADBE, INTU, CRM showing relative strength (all ABOVE TREND). Key risk: major divergence in large caps—NVDA, INTC, META showing material 1W weakness versus broader sector participation; monitor news flow and semiconductor internals.
